article.title: A forecast is not a promise

paragraphs.en: The organizers of an outdoor concert see a high probability of rain in the forecast. One member wants to cancel immediately; another says the uncertainty makes the forecast useless. Neither response considers what the forecast actually tells them or how serious the consequences could be.
paragraphs.zh: 户外音乐会的组织者看到预报显示下雨概率较高。一个人想立即取消，另一个却认为存在不确定性就说明预报毫无价值。这两种反应都没有考虑预报究竟说明什么，以及后果可能有多严重。

paragraphs.en: They anticipate wet weather and reserve a covered space as a precaution. The plan can change as conditions fluctuate. Staff also agree on a separate safety rule for severe conditions, rather than treating a light shower and dangerous winds as the same event.
paragraphs.zh: 他们预先考虑潮湿天气，并预订有顶棚的空间作为防范措施。随着天气变化，计划可以调整。工作人员还针对恶劣条件另定安全规则，而不是把小阵雨与危险大风当成同一种情况。

paragraphs.en: On the day, the rain arrives later than expected. The covered space is still useful, even though not every forecast detail was exact. Planning under uncertainty means preparing for plausible outcomes and updating the plan, not demanding perfect knowledge before taking any action.
paragraphs.zh: 当天，降雨比预期来得晚。有顶棚的空间仍然有用，即使预报的每个细节并不精确。在不确定条件下规划，意味着为合理的可能结果做好准备并更新方案，而不是等到完全知道一切后才行动。

article.title: More than a room of books

paragraphs.en: A neighborhood library has books, computers, and a quiet room, but staff members ask whether each resource is truly accessible. A computer is not much help to someone who cannot understand the instructions, and stairs can stop a visitor from reaching an otherwise open room.
paragraphs.zh: 一家社区图书馆有书籍、电脑和安静阅览室，但工作人员开始思考，每项资源是否真正可用。不懂操作说明的人难以从电脑中受益，楼梯也可能使访客无法到达一间本来开放的房间。

paragraphs.en: A new initiative pairs basic digital literacy sessions with simpler signs and an alternative entrance. To make the program inclusive, the library asks for feedback from people who have not used its services before. Regular visitors alone cannot explain every barrier.
paragraphs.zh: 一项新计划把基础数字素养课程、更简单的标识和另一处入口结合起来。为使项目更包容，图书馆征求了此前未使用其服务者的反馈。常来的访客无法解释所有障碍。

paragraphs.en: The first sessions are popular, but volunteers cannot sustain extra work indefinitely. The library reduces the timetable to something staff and volunteers can maintain together. A useful service must be welcoming at the door and practical to keep running after the excitement of its launch.
paragraphs.zh: 最初的课程很受欢迎，但志愿者无法无限期承担额外工作。图书馆缩减时间表，改为员工与志愿者能够共同维持的安排。一项有用的服务既要让人愿意走进来，也要能在刚推出的热情消退后继续运行。

article.title: Why the same shirt looks different

paragraphs.en: A designer makes three shirts from the same pattern. Their silhouette is similar, but their texture and movement are not. A stiff woven fabric holds its shape, while a softer cloth can drape close to the body. The pattern alone does not determine the final impression.
paragraphs.zh: 设计师用同一个版型制作三件衬衫。它们的轮廓相似，但纹理和动态不同。挺括机织布能保持形状，更柔软的布料则能顺着身体垂落。最终观感并非只由版型决定。

paragraphs.en: For a travel collection, the designer wants each piece to be versatile. A shirt should work with several outfits rather than depend on one elaborate accessory. The team tests it while sitting, walking, and carrying a bag, not only while standing still for a photograph.
paragraphs.zh: 在旅行系列中，设计师希望每件衣服都易于多种搭配。一件衬衫应适合几套造型，而非依赖一件繁复配饰。团队在坐、走路和背包时测试它，而不只让人静止站着拍照。

paragraphs.en: The final styling is understated: few ornaments, careful proportions, and a fabric chosen for how it behaves. This does not mean every garment must be plain. It means that details should support the intended experience rather than compete for attention without a reason.
paragraphs.zh: 最终造型较为含蓄：装饰少、比例讲究，并按面料的实际表现选材。这不意味着每件衣服都必须朴素，而是细节应服务于预期体验，不应无缘无故争抢注意力。

paragraphs.en: In a workshop, a young maker studies an old coat. Its craftsmanship is visible in small, even stitches and repairs made to preserve its shape. A decorative label alone would not show how well it was constructed or how much work went into it.
paragraphs.zh: 在工作室里，一位年轻制作者研究一件旧外套。细小均匀的针脚，以及为保持形状而做的修补，都体现了制作工艺。仅凭装饰标签，无法判断衣服的构造质量或投入了多少劳动。

paragraphs.en: The maker asks about its origin and whether the buttons are authentic to the period. An imitation button may look similar without sharing the same history. That does not automatically make a new button useless; it changes what someone can honestly say about the object.
paragraphs.zh: 制作者询问外套的来源，以及纽扣是否确属那个时期。仿制纽扣可能看起来相似，却没有相同历史。这并不意味着新纽扣必然无用，但会改变人们能够如何如实介绍这件物品。

paragraphs.en: For a contemporary design, she borrows a fastening method from local heritage but changes the proportions for current use. She describes the influence clearly instead of presenting the new coat as an untouched historical object. Respect for tradition can involve both continuity and transparent change.
paragraphs.zh: 在一款当代设计中，她借用了地方传统中的扣合方式，并为当前使用改变比例。她清楚说明这种影响，而不把新外套说成未经改动的历史旧物。尊重传统既可以包含延续，也可以包含公开说明的改变。

levels.title: The discount that cost more
levels.word: incentive · trade-off · consequence · rational · impulse · justify
levels.description: Six words, two kinds of practice, and one complete reading.

paragraphs.en: A shop offers a discount if customers buy three items. The offer creates an incentive to spend, even for people who came for one thing. Mira feels an impulse to add two shirts, then checks the total rather than focusing only on the reduced price of each item.
paragraphs.zh: 一家商店规定购买三件商品可打折。这个优惠给了人们多花钱的动机，即使他们原本只想买一件。米拉一时冲动，想再加两件衬衫，随后却先核对总价，而不是只看每件商品打折后的价格。

paragraphs.en: The choice involves a trade-off: buying more lowers the price per item but raises the amount spent today. The likely consequence depends on whether she will actually use the extra clothes. Three useful items and three unwanted items should not be treated as the same purchase.
paragraphs.zh: 选择涉及取舍：买得更多能降低单价，但会增加今天的总支出。可能的后果取决于她是否真的会用上额外衣服。三件实用商品与三件不想要的商品，不应被视作同一种购买。

paragraphs.en: Mira does not need to justify every preference as a mathematical rule. Still, a rational decision should consider her budget and purpose. She buys one shirt at the regular price and keeps money for repairing a coat she already wears. Missing a promotion can sometimes serve a larger plan.
paragraphs.zh: 米拉不必把每种偏好都说成数学规律。不过，理性的决定仍应考虑预算与目的。她按原价买了一件衬衫，把钱留作修补经常穿的外套。有时，错过促销反而有助于更大的计划。

levels.title: The map beyond the center
levels.word: urban · congestion · infrastructure · transit · commute · peripheral
levels.description: Six words, two kinds of practice, and one complete reading.

paragraphs.en: A city publishes a map of its new transit network. The urban center looks well connected, but a worker living in a peripheral neighborhood notices a long gap between buses. A route can exist on a map without providing a practical commute.
paragraphs.zh: 一座城市公布了新公共交通网络图。城市中心看起来连接良好，但住在外围社区的一名工作者注意到，公交班次间隔很长。地图上有路线，不代表就能提供实际可用的通勤。

paragraphs.en: The city wants to reduce congestion by encouraging people to leave cars at home. Yet better vehicles alone cannot replace the infrastructure needed to reach stops safely. Pavements, crossings, lighting, and service hours all affect whether a journey is possible.
paragraphs.zh: 城市希望鼓励人们把车留在家中，以缓解拥堵。然而，车辆更好并不能代替安全到达车站所需的基础设施。人行道、过街设施、照明和服务时段，都影响行程是否可行。

paragraphs.en: Officials try an early bus and a better crossing near a large workplace. They compare door-to-door journeys rather than only travel time inside the bus. The change helps some workers, while others still need different routes. A transport plan must consider the whole journey and the people least visible on its central map.
paragraphs.zh: 官员试行一班早车，并改善大型工作场所附近的过街设施。他们比较从家门到目的地的全程，而不只看坐在公交里的时间。这帮助了部分工作者，但其他人仍需要不同路线。交通规划必须考虑完整行程，以及在中心地图上最不显眼的人。

article.title: A better answer at the interview

paragraphs.en: During a practice interview, Dev knows the subject but struggles to articulate what he did on a project. His first answer is long and filled with details that are not relevant to the question. The interviewer asks what decision he personally made and why.
paragraphs.zh: 在模拟面试中，德夫熟悉相关主题，却难以清楚表达自己在项目里做了什么。他最初的回答很长，充满与问题无关的细节。面试者问他本人作出了什么决定，以及为什么。

paragraphs.en: Dev tries again with a concise description of the problem, his action, and its result. When the question is unclear, he learns to clarify its meaning before answering. A short pause can be more useful than immediately speaking about the wrong issue.
paragraphs.zh: 德夫再试一次，简明描述问题、自己的行动和结果。遇到问题不清楚时，他学会先澄清含义再作答。短暂停顿可能比立刻围绕错误问题开口更有用。

paragraphs.en: He also learns to acknowledge what he did not measure. He can assert that waiting time fell, but cannot claim that every customer became happier without evidence. A clear account combines confidence about supported facts with honesty about what remains unknown.
paragraphs.zh: 他也学会承认哪些情况没有测量。他可以明确表示等待时间缩短，却不能在没有证据时声称每位顾客都更满意。清晰说明既包含对有依据事实的信心，也包含对未知情况的坦诚。
